arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:8368ee01-5b52-4ca9-98b6-fc3f4b3b3: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:df89efc6-f5f6-40e6-8bab-1ae51fa29: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.

answer:a780af87-7ff2-4d59-a882-40cce375c: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
